source: 591 Information Gap
target: 591 Lacuna Notitiae

source: 591 Information Gap
target: 591 Lacuna Notitiae

source: Upon hearing Lumian’s inquiry, Madam Magician’s tone carried a subtle emotion.
target: Audita quaestione Lumiani, tonus Dominae Magicae affectum subtilissimum gerebat.

source: “Mr. Door is the ancestor of the Abraham family, the top duke among the five great nobles of the Tudor Empire.
target: „Dominus Door est progenitor familiae Abraham, et dux praeclarus inter quinque magnos nobles Imperii Tudoriani.“

source: It was He who sealed this spaceship.
target: Ipse est, qui hanc navem sideralem sigillavit.

source: Amon, on the other hand, designed the ritual that regularly siphoned power from the black hole to alleviate the pressure caused by the natural decay of the seal and hasten the black hole’s demise.”
target: Amon vero instituit caerimoniam quae regulariter potentiam ex foraminis nigri subtraheret, ut pressuram ex natura sigilli corruptionis levaret atque exitium foraminis acceleraret.”

source: Higher in rank than Amon… In the Tudor Empire, Mr. Door was second only to the Blood Emperor?
target: Maiore dignitate quam Amon… In Imperio Tudoriano, Dominus Door erat secundus solummodo post Imperatorem Sanguinis?

source: He listened intently.
target: Diligenter auscultavit.

source: Madam Magician sighed softly at that moment.
target: Domina Magica leniter suspiravit eo tempore.

source: “In a way, Mr. Door can be considered my mentor.”
target: „Quodammodo, Dominus Door meum praeceptor esse potest.”

source: A mentor? Your mentor is a Fourth Epoch King of Angels and the top noble in the Tudor Empire?
target: Praeceptor? Tuus praeceptor est Rex Angelorum Aetatis Quartae et summus nobilis in Imperio Tudoriano?

source: A figure from almost two thousand years ago…
target: Figura ex fere duo milia annorum abhinc…

source: Lumian hadn’t anticipated Madam Magician having such a profound background.
target: Lumian non exspectavit Dominae Magicae talem profundam originem habere.

source: No wonder she earned the position of the Angel of Stars beside Mr. Fool’s throne.
target: Non mirum est quod consequuta est officium Angeli Stellarum iuxta thronum Domini Stulti.

source: No wonder she held a Major Arcana card in the Tarot Club!
target: Non mirum quod tenuit chartam Arcana Maior in Club Taroticus!

source: Madam Magician glanced at Lumian, teasingly adding, “It’s true that Mr. Door guided and ‘supervised’ me in advancing along the divine path, but the method wasn’t as virtuous as you might imagine.
target: Domina Magica ad Lumian respexit, ludibriose addens: „Vero, Dominus Door me in progressu per viam divinam duxit et ‘supervisavit’, sed methodus non erat tam virtuosa quam putas.

source: It was far from good.”
target: Longe a bono erat.”

source: Far from good…
target: Longe a bono…

source: Lumian was surprised before connecting the dots.
target: Lumian miratus est antequam res coniungere coepit.

source: Combining his experiences, he made a guess.
target: Experientias suas coniunxit atque coniecturam egit.

source: Madam Magician had once fallen under the corruptive influence of Mr. Door but received assistance from Mr. Fool.
target: Domina Magica olim sub corruptivā influentiā Domini Door cecidit, sed auxilium a Domino Stulto accepit.

source: Did she join the Tarot Club because of this?
target: Num propter hoc in Club Taroticus se coniunxit?

source: However, from Madam Magician’s words, it seems she reconciled with Mr. Door?
target: Attamen, ex verbis Dominae Magicae videtur eam cum Domino Door reconciliatam esse?

source: Otherwise, she wouldn’t refer to Him as her mentor.
target: Alioquin eum non tamquam praeceptor suus appellaret.

source: How intriguing and surreal.
target: Quam mirabile et insolitum!

source: Just like how I might say in the future that the Angel of Inevitability, Termiboros, was my mentor, Lumian mused inwardly and probed, “Is Mr. Door still active?”
target: Sicut in futurum dicam Angelum Inevitabilitatis, Termiboros, fuisse meum praeceptor, Lumian intus meditatus ac interrogavit: „Num Dominus Door adhuc viget?”

source: Is He as lively as His peer, Amon?
target: Num ipse tam vivax est quam Amon?

source: Madam Magician shook her head.
target: Domina Magica caput in signum negationis inclinavit.

source: “He has perished.”
target: „Periit.”

source: I see…
target: Intelligo…

source: Lumian cast his gaze toward the deep, bottomless sea.
target: Lumian oculos suos ad profundum, insondabilem mare contulit.

source: “April Fool’s objective is to acquire that spaceship? But it seems they are unaware of the nascent black hole sealed inside…”
target: „Propositum Aprilis Stulti est hanc navem sideralem adipisci? Sed videtur eos nescire de foraminis nigri nascente intus sigillato...”

source: It was a formidable entity that not even a true god could completely neutralize.
target: Erat entitas formidabilis, quam ne verus deus omnino exstinguere poterat.

source: Once released from its seal and allowed to develop, it would compress and absorb everything in its vicinity.
target: Postquam sigillo solutum et evolvere concessum est, omnia circum se comprimere atque absorbere solebat.

source: Why did the key members of April Fool’s, who weren’t even at the demigod level, believe they could confront it without fear?
target: Cur principales Aprilis Stulti, qui ne gradus semideorum quidem attingebant, credebant se sine metu illud oppugnare posse?

source: Relying on the spaceship to contain it?
target: Fidem habere in nave siderali ut eam contineret?

source: That seemed improbable.
target: Id improbabile videbatur.

source: Only the evil god who created the black hole or an entity at Mr. Fool’s level could control it…
target: Solum deus malus, qui foramen nigrum creavit, aut entitas in ordine Domini Stulti eam regere poterat…

source: Mad Lady even believed that within the seal was an incubating deity or monster of a comparable magnitude…
target: Domina Insana etiam credidit intra sigillum deum vel monstrum inchoatum ex comparabili magnitudine esse…

source: With these thoughts in mind, Lumian’s heart stirred as he inquired in a deep voice, “Were the key members of April Fool’s misled?
target: His cogitationibus mentis, cor Lumiani concitatus est dum profunda voce interrogavit: „Num praecipui Aprilis Stulti decepti sint?

source: Is the Celestial Worthy’s objective to unleash the black hole and trigger an apocalyptic catastrophe ahead of schedule?
target: Num propositum Dignitatis Caelestis sit foramen nigrum efferre et calamitatem apocalypticam prae tempore suscitare?

source: “As long as Beyonders corrupted by Him enter the spaceship, He stands a chance of achieving His goal?”
target: „Dum ‘Beyonders’ ab Ipso corrupti navem sideralem ingrediuntur, habet occasionem propositum suum assequendi?”

source: He really doesn’t seem to value the lives of Ultraman, Mad Lady, Bard, and Loki…
target: Revera videtur vitam Ultraman, Domina Insana, Bard, et Loki non aestimare.

source: However, that is also typical of April Fool’s modus operandi.
target: Atque hoc quoque est modus operandi Aprilis Stulti.

source: They don’t take lives other than their own seriously!
target: Vitam aliorum quam suam non diligenter curant!

source: Lumian suddenly felt like laughing.
target: Lumian subito risum sentire coepit.

source: His satisfaction from finishing off Ultraman and Mad Lady intensified.
target: Satisfactio eius ex interficio Ultraman et Domina Insana intensificata est.

source: Madam Magician nodded thoughtfully and remarked, “If you hadn’t used all your resources and handled this matter with absolute strength, or if I had arrived ten to twenty seconds later and the grayish‐white fog from Mad Lady’s body had fully permeated the spaceship, the outcome might have been entirely different.
target: Domina Magica cogitabunda annuit et dixit: „Nisi omnia subsidia tua usus esses ac rem hanc vi absoluta administravisses, aut si ego decem ad viginti secundis postvenissem et nebula albocinerea ex corpore Dominae Insanae navem sideralem penitus pervadisset, exitus omnino aliter fuisset.

source: We wouldn’t be able to be here and discuss this matter so calmly.”
target: Non esset nobis licitum hic esse et rem hanc tam tranquillē disputare.”

source: Lumian reflected on the events that had transpired and muttered thoughtfully to himself, “If I hadn’t gained temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea and restricted Mad Lady’s teleportation, she might have approached the flesh-and-blood ‘bird’s nest’ incubating the black hole before your arrival.
target: Lumian eventa quae acciderant recoluit et sibi submurmuravit: „Nisi imperium temporarium ut Praefectus Maris acceperim et teleportationem Dominae Insanae cohiberim, illa fortasse ad nidum carnium avium, in quo foramen nigrum incuberet, ante adventum tuum accessisset.

source: She wouldn’t have manifested a humanoid form made of grayish‐white fog to infiltrate the spacecraft.
target: Non se effecerat in formam hominis ex nebula cinereo-alba factam ad navem sideralem intrandam.

source: If that had occurred, the situation might have been even more challenging to handle…”
target: Si id accidisset, res fortasse adhuc difficilior tractationi fuisset…

source: The reason he obtained temporary authority as the Governor of the Sea was because he utilized Lie to pilfer a portion of the sea’s power.
target: Causa cur imperium temporarium ut Praefectus Maris adeptus esset, erat quod Lie ad portionem potentiae maris subtrahere usus est.

source: This allowed him to resonate with the sea and possess a counterfeit yet highly elevated status.
target: Id ei concessit ut cum mari resonaret et statum simul fictum sed altissimum haberet.

source: The ability to use Lie to steal a portion of the sea’s power was granted by the Seer pathway’s mystical item, which had been imbued with a high-level power of Steal when placed on the ancestor‐honoring altar in Milo Village.
target: Facultas ut Lie partem potentiae maris subtraheret concessa est per rem mysticam viae vaticae, quae in altare progenitorum honorandum in vico Milo posita, potentia “Steal” altissimi gradus imbutata erat.

source: The altar could bestow high-level Steal powers on items because it was constructed by Amon…
target: Altare vires “Steal” altissimi gradus in obiecta conferre poterat, quia ab Amon constructum erat…

source: Constructed by Amon…
target: Amon aedificavit.

source: Lumian’s thoughts suddenly cleared up.
target: Cogitationes Lumiani subito perspicuae factae sunt.

source: He grasped that it wasn’t just him and the others sabotaging April Fool’s; there were also influential figures in the shadows who didn’t want the Celestial Worthy to succeed!
target: Intellectus eum pervenit non solum ipse et alii Aprilis Stulti sabotarent, sed etiam figuras influentes in umbris esse, qui Dignitatem Caelestem succedere noluerunt!

source: Madam Magician chuckled.
target: Domina Magica subridens risit.

source: “Have you figured it out? I recognized what was happening when I saw Lie, now endowed with the power of Steal.
target: „Intellexistine? Cognovi quid accideret, cum Lie, nunc potestate “Steal” imbutatus, viderem.

source: “Some time ago, I spied on the altar beneath Milo Village and confirmed its purpose—to gather the spirituality of worshippers and accumulate enough power to trigger the bestowment of the Steal ability.
target: Aliquando, altare sub vico Milo speculabar et eius propositum comprobatum habeo—spiritualitatem cultorum colligere atque satis potentiae congregare ad facultatem “Steal” conferendam.

source: Given Milo Village’s population and the number of individuals with the sea bloodline, it can only be bestowed once a year.
target: Ex populo vici Milo et numero hominum sanguinis marini, id unice semel in anno tribui potest.

source: It can’t last more than half a month each time, and it can only be used once or twice.
target: Neque plus quam dimidio mense quoque durare potest, et solum semel aut bis adhiberi potest.

source: “Lie’s enhanced power far surpasses that.”
target: „Potentia aucta Lie longe id superat.”

source: Lumian furrowed his brow and asked, “Are you suggesting that the ‘Steal’ on Lie was directly granted by Amon?”
target: Lumian frons contraxit et quaesivit: „Num putas potentiam ‘Steal’ in Lie directe a Amon concessam esse?”

source: This hypothesis struck him as absurd, comical, and surreal.
target: Haec hypothesis ei absurda, ridicula, et insolita videbatur.

source: In the past few months, Amon had been a source of terror, causing him mental distress.
target: In paucis mensibus praeteritis, Amon fons terroris, atque molestiam mentis ei afferens, fuit.

source: He nearly perished in the Samaritan Women’s Spring.
target: Prope periit in Fons Mulierum Samaritanarum.

source: Subsequently, he informed the Tarot Club and aided the Angel of Time in eliminating most of the Amons in Trier.
target: Postea, Societati Taroticae certiorem fecit et Angeli Temporis auxilio plerosque Amonos in Trier exterminare contulit.

source: He also wrested a substantial debt from Amon’s parasitic form.
target: Etiam debitum substantiale ex forma Amonis parasitica rapuit.

source: Their relationship?
target: Relatio eorum?

source: It was one of deep-seated enmity!
target: Erat inimicitia profunda!

source: The sentiment was likely mutual.
target: Forte affectus mutuus erat.

source: Yet now, he was being told that Amon had covertly assisted him?
target: At nunc, narratur ei quod Amon eum furtim adiuvit?

source: While Lumian understood that Amon’s aid wasn’t driven by benevolence but rather to thwart the Celestial Worthy’s objectives, he couldn’t shake the feeling that the world had taken a bizarre turn.
target: Dum Lumian intellexit auxilium Amonis non ex benevolentia sed ad adversanda propositis Dignitatis Caelestis datum esse, sensum tamen non poterat abicere quod mundus modo insolitum versaretur.

source: Madam Magician chuckled and explained, “Perhaps, back then, there was an Amon residing within the altar.
target: Domina Magica subridens explicavit: „Fortasse, tum, Amon in altare habitabat.

source: “Truth be told, I didn’t anticipate that those who once instilled awe, fear, and vigilance in our discussions would occasionally collaborate with us.
target: Verum dicam, non exspectabam eos, qui olim reverentiam, timorem, et vigiliam in sermo nostro inferebant, interdum nobiscum cooperare.

source: Of course, don’t become complacent.
target: Scilicet, ne complacere incipias.

source: While we may be teammates when facing the evil gods beyond the barrier, that doesn’t extend to all matters.
target: Dum socii esse possumus cum diis malis ultra limitem oppugnandis, hoc ad omnia negotia non pertinet.

source: Even when dealing with the evil god’s followers, it depends on the specific circumstances.
target: Etiam cum sectatoribus dei mali agitur, id circumstantiis pendet.

source: They might believe they can handle it alone and use the opportunity to set a trap that could harm you.”
target: Fortasse existimabunt se id soli regere posse atque occasionem ad laqueum tendendum, quod te laedere possit, adhibere.

source: “Alright…”
target: „Recte...”

source: Lumian resisted belief, but he had no choice but to acknowledge the reality before him.
target: Lumian fides repugnans, sed nullam aliud viam habuit nisi rem praesentem agnoscere.

source: The truth was laid bare.
target: Vera manifesta erant.

source: Having been briefed, Lumian mentally reconstructed the sea prayer ritual, refining the spiderweb-like thought pattern without any critical deficiencies.
target: Notitiam accepit, et Lumian in mente caerimoniam preces maris refecit, rationem cogitationis telam similem sine defectibus criticis recensens.

source: The corresponding experiences and lessons surfaced in Lumian’s mind:
target: Experientiae atque lectiones in animo Lumiani apparuerunt:

source: April Fool’s biggest failure was not knowing that Franca and I are also members of the Tarot Club, apart from being part of the Curly-Haired Baboons Research Society.
target: Maxima defectio Aprilis Stulti fuit nescire Francam et me etiam membra Club Taroticus esse, praeterquam esse partem Societatis Investigationis Papionum Crisporum.

source: Moreover, the Tarot Club places great importance on matters related to the Celestial Worthy…
target: Praeterea, Club Taroticus rebus ad Dignitatem Caelestem pertinentibus magnum pretium tribuit…

source: There’s also an information gap between them and the Celestial Worthy, leading to their downfall…
target: Exstat etiam lacuna notitiae inter eos et Dignitatem Caelestem, quae ad eorum ruinam ducit…

source: Have they not considered that their goals might not align with the Celestial Worthy’s?
target: Num non animadvertere putaverunt, eorum proposita non convenire posse cum Dignitate Caelesti?

source: Despite me lacking information as well, I wasn’t careless.
target: Quamquam et mihi notitia defuit, non temerarius fui.

source: I didn’t underestimate any visible or hidden enemies.
target: Nullos hostes visibiles aut occulti subestimavi.

source: Even a lion uses its full strength to hunt a rabbit…
target: Etiam leo totam vim suam ad leporem venandum adhibet…

source: Of course, the crucial aspect is that those holding key information and concealing it are on my side in this operation.
target: Certe, elementum praecipuum est quod qui informationem claram retinent et eam celant, in hac operatione mihi adsunt.

source: What if they become my enemies next time?
target: Quid si in futurum hostes mei fient?

source: How should I deal with them…
target: Quomodo eos tractare debeam?

source: As these thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian sensed that his digestion of the Conspirer potion had significantly advanced, thanks to the successful hunt and the questions he had formulated.
target: Dum hae cogitationes in mente eius volitabant, Lumian sensit digestionem potionis Conspiratoris note profectam esse, propter venationem felicem ac interrogationes suas formatas.

source: Seizing this opportunity, he summarized his third acting principle:
target: Hanc occasionem capiens, tertium principium agendi suum summatim enuntiavit:

source: “One of the keys to a conspiracy is information.
target: „Una ex clavibus ad coniurationem est notitia.

source: A good Conspirer must be adept at exploiting information gaps and even take the initiative to create information gaps.”
target: Bonus coniurator peritus esse debet in exploenda lacuna notitiae atque initiative eam creare.

source: Closing his eyes to assess his body’s condition, Lumian felt that another major, successful conspiracy and a period of daily accumulation should allow him to completely digest the Conspirer potion.
target: Oculos clausos habens ad statum corporis perscrutandum, Lumian sensit aliam magnam et felicem coniurationem, cum tempore aggregationis cotidianæ, ei concedere posse ut potionem Conspiratoris plane digeret.

source: And that major conspiracy could be combined with the ritual to advance to Sequence 5 Reaper.
target: Et illa magna coniuratio cum caerimonia coniungi poterat ad Sequencam 5 Reaper progrediendam.

source: No further planning was needed.
target: Nulla ulteriō consilia necessaria erant.

source: The Reaper ritual required a conspiracy to capture a target whose Sequence was higher than his—alive.
target: Caerimonia Reaper coniurationem poscebat ad captandum scopus, cuius Sequenca altior quam eius esset—vivus.

source: When Lumian opened his eyes, Madam Magician transmitted the darkness in her palm to him.
target: Cum Lumian oculos aperuisset, Domina Magica tenebras ex palma sua ei tradidit.

source: “You’ll be in charge of distributing these items.
target: „Tu eris responsalis distributionis harum rerum.

source: This is something a Hunter needs to learn and do well to advance to a demigod.”
target: Hoc est rem, quam Venator discere et commode agere debet ad ascensum ad semideum consequendum.”

source: “Alright.”
target: „Recte.”

source: Lumian was accustomed to distributing spoils of war.
target: Lumian ad praediorum belli distributionem assuefactus erat.

source: He then added, “But before that, I’d like to meet Bard.”
target: Deinde addidit: „Sed ante hoc, Bard convenire velim.”

source: That, too, was a spoil of war.
target: Id quoque praeda belli erat.

source: In the ancient and dilapidated palace in the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian, Franca, Hela, and Gandalf materialized one after another.
target: In antiquo et dilapidato palatio in Natione Semper Noctis, Lumian, Franca, Hela, et Gandalf unum post alium apparuerunt.

source: They were adorned in their usual attire for Gatherings, with Lumian now assuming the guise of Muggle Aurore.
target: Induti erant vestimentis consuētis conventuum, et Lumian nunc effigie Muggle Aurore se praebebat.

source: Gandalf unceremoniously tossed Bard to the ground, not bothering to restrain him.
target: Gandalf Bard sine caerimonia in terram iacuit, eum continere non curans.

source: Bard surveyed the familiar surroundings, devoid of any notions of escape or resistance.
target: Bard circumstantias notas perspexit, nullo cogitatione de fuga aut repugnatione.

source: This was the concealed Nation of the Evernight, isolated from the outside world.
target: Haec erat Natione Semper Noctis celata, a mundo externo segregata.

source: How could he possibly flee?
target: Quomodo potuit in quovis modo effugere?

source: And against two demigods, how could he even attempt resistance?
target: Et contra duos semideos, quomodo etiam repugnationem conari posset?

source: Bard swallowed hard and spoke preemptively, “I was also bewitched by Loki!”
target: Bard avidē deglutivit et praeempta loquens dixit: „Ego quoque a Loki incantatus sum!”

source: All he could hope for now was that, leveraging his Sequence experience as a Swindler, he could successfully “convince” the two demigods.
target: Omne quod nunc sperare poterat, erat ut, sua experientia Sequencae ut Fraudator usurpata, duos semideos feliciter “persuadere” posset.

source: Noticing the silence from Hela and Gandalf, Bard added, “I can lead you to Loki’s ancient castle.
target: Silentes verba Helae et Gandalfi animadvertens, Bard addidit: „Vos ad antiquum castellum Loki ducere possum.

source: I know a clue, really!”
target: Revera, scio aliquod indicium!”

source: At that moment, Lumian Lee, masquerading as Muggle, spoke in a deep voice, “Just kill him and channel his spirit.”
target: Illo momento, Lumian Lee, sub specie Muggle, voce profunda locutus est: „Interfice illum et spiritum eius dirige.”
